# IAssetsForwarder
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/AssetsForwarder/IAssetsForwarder.sol)

**Inherits:**

**Title:**
IAssetsForwarder

Interface for the AssetsForwarder contract


## Functions
### forwardAsset

Pulls assets from the caller and sends them to the target address


```solidity
function forwardAsset(address targetAddress, address asset, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetAddress`|`address`|The address to receive the assets|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset to transfer|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to transfer|


### sendAsset

Sends existing assets in the contract to the target address


```solidity
function sendAsset(address targetAddress, address asset, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetAddress`|`address`|The address to receive the assets|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset to transfer|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to transfer|


### sweepAsset

Sends existing assets in the contract to the caller (keeper)


```solidity
function sweepAsset(address asset, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset to sweep|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to sweep|
